I have successfully created and configured an automatic message filter for subfolders in Thunderbird.

**Filter Details:**
- **Filter Name:** Subfolder Filter
- **Trigger:** Automatically runs when getting new mail
- **Condition:** Subject contains "*subfolder*"
- **Action:** Moves matching messages to the Bills subfolder under Local Folders
- **Status:** Enabled

The filter is now active and will automatically process incoming messages that match the criteria. Messages with "subfolder" in their subject line will be automatically moved to the Bills folder instead of staying in the Inbox or being processed by other filters.

You can verify the filter is working by checking the Message Filters dialog (accessible via the "Manage message filters" button in the toolbar), where the "Subfolder Filter" should appear with a checkmark in the Enabled column.
